title: ScaleBench: A Reproducible Scoreboard for Auto-Renormalization in Weather Modeling
description: Adjudication-first public benchmark for auto-renormalization in weather modeling. Five task families (Known-Recovery, Cross-Resolution, Long-Horizon, Discovery, Extrapolation + Chaos-Audit), deterministic leaderboard v1.2 (overall 0.9504), executable arbitration via reproduce.py, live AIFS comparison harness with sha256-provenance rolling archive and measured baselines (12-120h). Public page: https://dolo-borigjin.github.io/The-everything/
